# SAS Travels

> Luxury travel studio curating India domestic tours and international journeys from Coastal Karnataka to Egypt, UAE, Maldives, Thailand and Malaysia.

SAS Travels designs premium, handcrafted itineraries for travellers seeking considered pacing, local expertise and seamless logistics. Founded in India, the studio specialises in coastal Karnataka getaways and aspirational international destinations.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Discover curated tours, destinations and travel inspiration.
- [Domestic Tours](/domestic-tours): India tour packages including Coastal Karnataka highlights.
- [International Tours](/international-tours): International packages across Egypt, UAE, Maldives, Thailand and Malaysia.
- [Egypt Tours](/egypt): Dedicated Egypt packages and itineraries.
- [Destinations](/destinations): Browse destinations and related tour packages.
- [Tour Details](/tours/udupi-mangaluru-coastal-karnataka): Example tour page with itinerary, pricing, gallery and reviews.
- [Blogs](/blogs): Travel stories, destination guides and planning tips.
- [Blog Post](/blogs/travel-tips): Example article from the SAS Travels journal.
- [Custom Itinerary](/custom-itinerary): Request a bespoke, tailor-made journey.
- [About](/about): The SAS Travels story, values and team philosophy.
- [Contact](/contact): Speak with a specialist to plan your next trip.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about bookings, payments and travel.
- [Visa](/visa): Visa guidance and support for travellers.
- [Travel Insurance](/travel-insurance): Medical, trip and baggage coverage plans.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Travel photography and destination inspiration.
